IN_BAM.description: Input BAM or CRAM file path (e.g., /path/sample.bam), which containing base modification tags (e.g. MM, ML). Must be coordinate-sorted and indexed.

OUT_BED.description: Output file or directory for writing bedMethyl (or bedMethyl.gz) formatted output,Output bedMethyl file path (e.g., /path/output.bed)

--preset.description: Apply a pre-defined set of options for specific applications (e.g. 'traditional' for CpG 5mC analysis).

--threads.description: Number of threads to use for pileup generation.

--ref.description: Reference FASTA file. Required if using motif filtering (e.g. --cpg).

--output-prefix.description: Prefix for output files. Useful when writing multiple output formats.

--log-filepath.description: Write log messages to this file instead of standard error.

--num-reads.description: Number of reads to sample when estimating filtering thresholds.

--filter-threshold.description: Filter threshold for modification probability (global or per-base, e.g. 0.75 or C:0.8).

--min-coverage.description: Minimum number of reads required at a site to report it.

--max-coverage.description: Maximum read coverage per site; reads beyond this will be ignored.

--cpg.description: Restrict analysis to CpG motifs only (requires reference).

--mod-threshold.description: Minimum modification probability to consider a site modified.

--invert-edge-filter.description: Keep only modification calls at the read ends instead of removing them.

--output-format.description: Specify output format (bedMethyl, bedMethyl.gz, or modkit TSV).

--ignore-read-groups.description: Do not separate data by BAM read group tags (RG).

--chunk-size.description: Number of bases per chunk when processing genome in parallel.

--output-column-descriptions.description: Print descriptions of output columns and exit.

IN_BAM.description: Input BAM or CRAM file containing raw or outdated modification tags.

OUT_BAM.description: Output BAM file with updated MM/ML tags based on new base modification probabilities.

--mod-base-table.description: Table mapping canonical bases to modified base symbols and probabilities.

--prob-threshold.description: Probability threshold for assigning modification tags.

--clear-existing.description: Remove existing modification tags before updating.

--threads.description: Number of worker threads to use.

--output-column-descriptions.description: Print output column descriptions and exit.

IN_BAM.description: Input BAM file with base modification probabilities (ML tags).

OUT_TSV.description: Output TSV file containing sampled modification probabilities per base or motif.

--num-samples.description: Number of reads to sample from input BAM.

--include-mods.description: Only include reads with specified modification codes (comma-separated).

--ref.description: Reference FASTA file for motif lookup if needed.

--threads.description: Number of parallel threads for sampling.

--output-column-descriptions.description: Print output column descriptions and exit.

IN_BAM.description: Input BAM or CRAM file containing base modification tags (MM/ML).

OUT_TSV.description: Output text file summarizing modification types and statistics.

--ref.description: Reference FASTA file for canonical base matching and strand determination.

--filter-threshold.description: Minimum probability required for a modification to be counted as passing.

--include-mods.description: Comma-separated list of modification codes to include in the summary (e.g. m, h, a).

--combine-strands.description: Combine modification counts from both strands.

--threads.description: Number of worker threads for summary computation.

--output-column-descriptions.description: Print descriptions of output columns (totals table + modification calls table).

output_column_descriptions: bases: list of canonical bases with modification calls
total_reads_used: total number of reads with base modification calls
count_reads_{base}: number of reads with modifications per base
code: modification code or '-' for canonical

IN_BAM.description: Input modBAM file containing ML probability tags for base modifications.

OUT_BAM.description: Output BAM file with modification calls set to 100% or 0% based on probability thresholds.

--threshold.description: Probability threshold above which a modification is called (default 0.8).

--ref.description: Reference FASTA file (optional for motif or base alignment validation).

--include-mods.description: Comma-separated list of modification codes to include when calling.

--threads.description: Number of threads for BAM processing.

--output-column-descriptions.description: Print column definitions for modification call summary (e.g., position, base, prob, call).

IN_BAM.description: Input modBAM file with MM and ML tags containing base modification information.

OUT_TSV.description: Output TSV table of per-read modification calls and probabilities.

--ref.description: Reference FASTA file for coordinate alignment and motif labeling.

--include-mods.description: Comma-separated list of modification codes to extract.

--combine-strands.description: Combine calls across strands (output strand column as '.').

--min-prob.description: Minimum probability threshold for including modification calls.

--threads.description: Number of threads for parallel extraction.

--output-column-descriptions.description: Print description of TSV columns (chrom, pos, strand, base, mod_code, prob, read_id).

output_column_descriptions: base: canonical base at the position
mod_code: modification code (e.g., m, h, a)
prob: probability assigned to the modification (from ML tag)

OUT_BAMDONOR_BAM.description: Donor BAM file containing correct MM/ML tags. Must be sorted by read name.

OUT_BAMACCEPTOR_BAM.description: Acceptor BAM file with missing or incorrect MM/ML tags. Must be sorted by read name.

OUT_BAM.description: Output BAM file with repaired modification tags from donor.

--log-filepath.description: Log file to record repair events and rejected reads.

--threads.description: Number of threads used during tag repair.

output_column_descriptions: read_id: read name from acceptor BAM
tags_repaired: list of tags transferred from donor (e.g., MM, ML)

OUT_BAMSAMPLE1_BEDMETHYL.description: First sample as bgzip-compressed bedMethyl with tabix index.

OUT_BAMSAMPLE2_BEDMETHYL.description: Second sample as bgzip-compressed bedMethyl with tabix index.

OUT_BAMOUT_BED.description: Output BED file containing regions with methylation difference scores.

output_column_descriptions: score: magnitude of methylation difference between samples

IN_BAM.description: Input BAM file, must be sorted and indexed.

-o, --out-bed.description: Output bedMethyl file. Defaults to stdout if not provided.

--cpg.description: Aggregate double-stranded base modifications for CpG dinucleotides.

--motif.description: Specify a sequence motif and offset for pileup (e.g., --motif CG 0).

--threads.description: Number of threads for concurrent processing.

--no-filtering.description: Include all mod base calls without filtering.

--filter-threshold.description: Global or per-base filter threshold for mod calls.

--mod-threshold.description: Passing threshold for a specific base modification (e.g., h:0.8).

--sample-region.description: Region to sample reads from when estimating filtering threshold.

--bam-and-bed.description: Specify BAM and corresponding BED file with ground truth modified base positions. Can be repeated for multiple samples.

-c, --canonical-base.description: Canonical base to evaluate (A, C, G, T). Required if ground truth uses only canonical sites.

--edge-filter.description: Discard mod calls within this many bases from start/end of read. Two comma-separated values allowed for asymmetric filtering.

--invert-edge-filter.description: Keep only base modification calls at read ends instead of filtering them out.

--min-identity.description: Minimum alignment identity (Q-space) for reads to be used.

--min-length.description: Minimum alignment length to retain reads.

-p, --filter-quantile.description: Filter out calls below specified confidence percentile.

--filter-threshold.description: Override filter quantile with absolute probability threshold.

search.description: Search for modification-enriched motifs in reference genome.

refine.description: Refine previously defined motifs using bedMethyl table.

evaluate.description: Calculate enrichment statistics for a set of motifs from a bedMethyl table.

bed.description: Create BED file of all locations of a motif (e.g., modkit motif bed CG 0).

--in-bam.description: Input mod-BAM file(s). Can be repeated.

-n, --num-positions.description: Number of modified positions to consider at a time.

-w, --window-size.description: Maximum interval length that 'num_positions' can occur in.

--motif.description: Motif(s) to use for entropy calculation. Can be repeated.

--cpg.description: Use CpG motifs. Short-hand for --motif CG 0 --combine-strands.

--base.description: Primary sequence base for modification entropy calculation.

--regions.description: File specifying regions over which to calculate statistics.

--combine-strands.description: Combine counts from positive and negative strands, report on positive strand.

--min-coverage.description: Minimum coverage to consider a position valid.

--max-filtered-positions.description: Max filtered positions allowed per read in window.

--no-filtering.description: Do not filter any mod base calls.

--mod-threshold.description: Passing threshold for specific base modifications.

OUT_BAMIN_BEDMETHYL.description: Input bedMethyl table (bgzip-compressed with Tabix index).

--regions.description: BED file of regions to calculate enrichment around.

-w, --window.description: Number of base pairs upstream/downstream to search around region midpoint.

-s, --stranded.description: Only keep records on 'same' or 'opposite' strand.

--stranded-features.description: Force use of specific strand: positive, negative, or both.

--min-coverage.description: Minimum coverage to use a record.

--chart.description: Create plots showing % modification vs offset.

--name.description: Name for HTML document and chart.

OUT_BAMIN_BEDMETHYL.description: Input bedMethyl table (bgzip-compressed with Tabix index).

--regions.description: BED file of regions to aggregate base modifications over.

-c, --mod-codes.description: Which base modification codes to report. Default reports all encountered.

--no-header.description: Do not write header to output table.

merge.description: Merge two or more bedMethyl files, summing counts for overlapping records.

tobigwig.description: Convert bedMethyl file to BigWig format.

check-tags.description: Check that modBAM tags are present and correctly formatted.

predict.description: Identify regions of open chromatin using exogenous 6mA signal.

IN_BAM.description: Input BAM or CRAM file containing base modification tags to adjust.

OUT_BAM.description: Output BAM/CRAM file to write adjusted modification tags to.

--ref.description: Reference FASTA file for base matching and coordinate validation.

--reverse.description: Reverse the strand of modification calls during adjustment.

--include.description: Comma-separated list of modification codes to include (e.g. m, h).

--exclude.description: Comma-separated list of modification codes to exclude (e.g. h, c).

--clear.description: Clear all modification tags (MM, ML) before applying adjustments.

--threads.description: Number of threads for BAM processing.

--log-filepath.description: Write log messages to a specified file.

--output-column-descriptions.description: Print descriptions of output columns and exit.
